# Erfan Boostan

> AI product engineer based in Nicosia (Lefkoşa), Cyprus. Builds complete products with AI, from the idea and design to the code, testing and launch. Built Team Memory, his own live AI product, by directing AI coding tools such as Claude Code. Also worked on two apps live on the App Store and Google Play (KibRide, Automech) in Kotlin Multiplatform, React and Next.js. Open to remote contract work and to relocation.

Last updated: 2026-10-14

## Location and availability

- Based in Nicosia (Lefkoşa), Cyprus. Time zone: Eastern European Time, UTC+2 in winter and UTC+3 in summer.
- Works remotely. Available for remote contract work and for contract or full-time roles, including ones that involve relocation.

## How he builds

- Builds whole products with AI: he directs AI coding tools such as Claude Code to write the code, and the product decisions, design, testing and launch are his.
- Team Memory (324 automated tests) and the AI Customer Assistant (62 automated checks and an end-to-end browser test) were both built this way.
- Inside his products he uses the Claude API, including tool use and prompt caching.

## Work

- [Team Memory](https://www.teammemory.online): Own product, built by directing AI coding tools; live since October 2026, early stage. AI that reads the group chats a team connects (Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord), finds decisions, promises, ideas and open questions linked to their source messages, and reminds the right person before they are forgotten. Privacy-first (announces itself, per-team encryption, 90-day retention). Next.js, Supabase and the Claude API; web dashboard with a 3D memory map and a Claude connector; 324 automated tests.
- [AI Customer Assistant](https://github.com/er369ai/ai-customer-assistant): Own product, working prototype (Oct 2026), built by directing Claude Code. AI that answers a small business's customers in Turkish, English, Russian and Persian from the business's own stock and prices, saves leads through LLM tool use and reminds the owner about uncalled leads. Editions for car galleries and estate agencies. Python and the Claude API; 62 automated checks and an end-to-end browser test.
- [KibRide](https://kktc.kibride.com): Ride-hailing platform for North Cyprus, live on the App Store and Google Play (com.kibride.passenger.android). Worked on it as Mobile Developer at RingosTechnology. Kotlin Multiplatform with shared Android/iOS logic, Firebase Auth, Firestore, real-time trip tracking between passenger and driver.
- [Automech](https://auto-mate-landing.vercel.app): Mechanic marketplace live on Google Play in Cyprus, Greece, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Germany (app.automateonline.user). Contract Frontend & UI/UX Developer: designed and deployed the product site in React/Next.js/Tailwind, and delivered the UI/UX for the consumer and mechanic apps and the Instagram launch content.
- [Vibe Quest](https://vibequest-ten.vercel.app): Own product concept, a real-world meetup and skill-swap platform for Cyprus. Positioning, information architecture, revenue model and the full marketing site.
- [KKTC Web](https://kktcweb-er369ais-projects.vercel.app): Own fixed-price, one-week website service for small businesses in Kyrenia and Nicosia. Turkish copy and conversion-focused design. Clients are found with his own Python outreach tool: it collects businesses from listing sites, cleans contact data, deduplicates against his WhatsApp history (about 3,400 businesses so far) and drafts each message with the Claude API; he reviews and sends every one by hand. Demo sites for clients: [car gallery](https://er369ai.github.io/galeri/), [estate listings](https://er369ai.github.io/emlak/).
